headline: Stonecradle Erupts as Furious Combat Engulfs Dead Lands and Mooring County
war_summary: Frontline momentum has shifted sharply into Stonecradle, where five strategic base transfers unfolded within the past two hours amid furious fighting over World's End and The Dais. Neighboring Mooring County remains equally volatile, logging three fresh base actions as combat presses around The Wind Hills. While direct territorial turnover in Weathered Expanse has halted over the last two hours, the sector continues to grind through manpower, recording nearly thirty-five hundred casualties in that brief span. A similar bloodbath has erupted across the Dead Lands, where casualty rates are accelerating rapidly, claiming over thirty-five hundred men in two hours with Warden ranks bearing the heavier toll. Further west, Nevish Line has caught fire with enlistments spiking and Colonial losses climbing past seven hundred across two hours. By contrast, the fierce engagements previously observed in Linn of Mercy have tapered off into a cooling trend, while Fisherman's Row and Callahan's Passage remain thoroughly quieted along their respective fronts.
